definitions.level: Previous completed regular session low; target previous session high.
definitions.sweep: Completed 5m candle low strictly below level, close strictly above level.
definitions.pivot: Most recent same-session high strictly greater than two highs on each side; right-side candles must finish before sweep candle begins.
definitions.atr: Mean true range of previous 14 completed 5m candles, including overnight gaps; never current candle.
definitions.confirmation: Within 30 wall-clock minutes after sweep close: bullish body >= body_atr_multiple * prior ATR, close above frozen pre-sweep confirmed pivot high.
definitions.gap: Exactly next completed candle after confirmation: its low > high two candles earlier by at least minimum_gap; three candles must be contiguous and confirmation must follow sweep.
definitions.entry: Sweep/confirmed use next observed minute open; full uses later buy limit at gap low + gap_fraction * gap width, active only after third candle closes.
definitions.expiry: Market entry valid one minute; limit valid retest_bars * 5 wall-clock minutes; orders expire at scheduled final-minute open.
definitions.invalidation: Before fill: cancel if price trades below original sweep low, or stop/target passed at minute open. Incomplete 5m candle cancels unfilled setup/order.
definitions.execution: Buy limit touch fills at limit or improved opening price, with bps costs separately debited. Stop gaps sell at worse open. Stop wins if both stop and target touched. No target credited during an intraminute limit-fill candle unless filled at open; stop still wins. Reopening events timestamped no earlier than verified halt end.
definitions.sizing: Whole shares; planned risk including entry/stop costs <= 0.5% current equity; gross purchase plus costs <= cash; no leverage, no pyramiding, at most one filled trade per day.
definitions.exit: Protective stop, previous-day high target, or market at scheduled final-minute open; no overnight position.
definitions.comparison: Same fresh-cash combined/discovery/reused-validation windows and costs for variants and buy-and-hold. Cached production Turtle statistics are contextual, with different risk, sizing and terminal policy.
definitions.selection: No best-strategy selection or tuning; report all predefined sensitivity cases. Reused validation is not unseen data.
